publicSummary.title: Callback mailbox ownership is enforced in router and MCP
publicSummary.summary: A parallel attacker found that unowned controllers could inspect or mutate owned callback subscriber mailboxes. The integrated fix requires exact ownerRunId for registration and mailbox operations.
